about: A weekly series whose rule names its hour (BYDAY=MO;BYHOUR=9;BYMINUTE=30, Berlin), one day renamed and tagged here, another day deleted, then the series start moved an hour at Google by another client, not yet read, then the rename undone: the undo reads and stores the series, whose days stay at 09:30 by the rule, so the day is still a day and the undo goes through (Slice 3a; x-choice, x-undo-fields). Fresh seed 37440 case 222, shrunk: the harness read the day at the start's new clock and called it stale, a check defect.
